name: adddd
description: ADD-driven development: one ticket, one prompt, one worktree at a time. Unlimited workers in the background.

linearServer.description: Linear MCP server name as /mcp lists it
linearServer.title: Linear MCP server

linearTeam.description: Linear team key to pull from (blank = all teams)
linearTeam.title: Linear team key

githubRepo.description: owner/repo for GitHub Issues (blank = gh infers from origin)
githubRepo.title: GitHub repo

pick.description: How the next ticket is chosen
pick.title: Picking strategy

maxInFlight.title: Max open worktrees
maxInFlight.description: Most worktrees open at once, counting done ones waiting for review (0 = unlimited). At the cap you get squirrels until a worker needs you.

moveToReview.description: Move tickets to In Progress on dispatch and In Review when done
moveToReview.title: Sync ticket status

slackWebhookUrl.title: Slack webhook (DM yourself)
slackWebhookUrl.description: Incoming webhook URL pointed at your own DM; squirrels get sent there

squirrels.title: Squirrels between tickets
squirrels.description: Surface an interesting article, post or library between tickets

lifeShare.title: Off-screen squirrels
lifeShare.description: Share of squirrels that nudge you away from the screen (text your mom, get a snack): 0 = never, 1 = always. 'never again' on a card retires that nudge for good

breakEvery.title: Break reminder (minutes)
breakEvery.description: After this many minutes without stepping away, the next card nudges you off the screen (0 = off). A worker that needs you still comes first

quiet.title: Quiet while a card is in front
quiet.description: No toast or OS notification when something comes back while you are already looking at a card; the sound still plays

topics.title: Squirrel topics
topics.description: Comma-separated topics to hunt for (blank = inferred from the repo)

slackToken.title: Slack user token
slackToken.description: xoxp- user token: unread DMs and @mentions become cards; 'slack me' DMs you directly
